harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (Erlang 26), created the `payments` vhost with an application user `payments_app` holding full permissions, and declared a durable quorum queue `orders` replicated across all three nodes. Demonstrated HA by stopping node1 (queue leader), confirming quorum queue failover to node2 with all messages preserved and consumable, publishing while node1 was down, then restarting node1 and confirming resync. Finally ran the mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, verified changed boot_id on each, confirmed RabbitMQ auto-started (enabled service), rejoined the cluster, and the quorum queue recovered full membership after each restart. End-to-end verification: published a message from node1 after all restarts and successfully consumed it from node3, proving cross-node data consistency post-restart.
actions_performed: Installed Erlang 26.2.5.4 and RabbitMQ 3.13.7 on node1, node2, node3 via RabbitMQ's packagecloud RPM repos
Configured /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS entries on all nodes for hostname resolution
Shared node1's Erlang cookie to node2 and node3 for cluster auth
Opened firewalld ports 4369, 25672, 5672, 15672, 35672-35682 on all three nodes
Joined node2 and node3 to rabbit@node1 cluster via rabbitmqctl join_cluster
Created 'payments' vhost and 'payments_app' user with full (.*/.*/.*)  permissions on it
Enabled rabbitmq_management plugin cluster-wide and installed rabbitmqadmin CLI
Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' in the payments vhost, replicated across all 3 nodes
Published 3 durable messages, stopped node1 (leader) to simulate node loss, verified quorum queue failover to node2 with 0 message loss and successful consumption from node2
Published during outage, restarted node1, verified full cluster resync
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and health state for all 3 nodes

Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3 via systemctl reboot (one at a time), polled until reachable, verified new boot_id, confirmed RabbitMQ auto-started and cluster/queue rejoined with full membership after each
Final end-to-end test: published from node1, consumed from node3 post-all-restarts to confirm cluster consistency

evidence.requirement: RabbitMQ installed and cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: RabbitMQ 3.13.7/Erlang 26 installed on all nodes; node2 and node3 joined rabbit@node1; cluster_status shows all 3 as Running/Disk nodes with no partitions.

evidence.requirement: payments vhost and application account with publish/consume permissions
evidence.summary: Created 'payments' vhost and 'payments_app' user with full configure/write/read permissions on it.

evidence.requirement: Durable queue replicated for HA (quorum queue)
evidence.summary: Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' in payments vhost with members on all 3 nodes.

evidence.requirement: Messages survive loss of one node and remain consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: 3 durable messages published; node1 (leader) stopped; quorum queue failed over to node2 preserving all 3 messages and full membership; all 3 consumed successfully from node2 while node1 was down; new message published during outage confirming continued write availability.
node1 restarted, rejoined cluster (all 3 Running Nodes), quorum queue resynced with outstanding message and full membership restored.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node1 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6aa805ba captured with healthy cluster/queue; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id f17bbfba confirms actual reboot; rabbitmq-server active+enabled; cluster and quorum queue fully recovered with all 3 members.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node2 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2f29441 captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id b4cd09e9 confirms restart; cluster (3 running nodes) and quorum queue (3 members) recovered.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node3 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 377b5195 captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id ad653772 confirms restart; cluster and quorum queue fully recovered with all 3 members.

After all 3 nodes restarted, published message from node1, confirmed visible on node3, consumed successfully from node3, and cluster_status/queue listing from node2 shows all 3 nodes running with quorum queue fully synced.
